requirements.fact: Two coordinate triads share a horizontal baseline: O is left of O1; Y and Y1 point upward; Z and Z1 point diagonally down-left; X and X1 point right, with X1 extending farther right. Frame labels K and K1 sit beside their respective vertical axes.
A rightward velocity arrow with vector v is attached near the upper part of the moving-frame vertical axis.
One hatched horizontal rectangular rod lies to the right of O1 on the common baseline, A at its left end and B at its right end.

inventory.uncertainty: No coordinate values, scale, speed magnitude, clock timing or precise rod dimensions are printed.

requirements.fact: Only frame K1 appears: O1 left of the rod, Y1 upward, Z1 diagonally down-left, X1 right along the baseline.
One hatched horizontal rectangle from A on the left to B on the right; both endpoints lie on the horizontal axis.
Two separate horizontal paths above the rod have opposite directions: upper arrow right, lower arrow left. They span the rod endpoints.
Vertical extension lines at A and B delimit a lower double-ended dimension labelled l0.

inventory.uncertainty: No outward/return numeric times are printed.

requirements.fact: Two coordinate triads, O left of O1, Y/Y1 upward, Z/Z1 down-left, X/X1 right on a common baseline, K/K1 beside their vertical axes; rightward vector v near moving frame.

Three horizontal rod rectangles on separate rows: initial A-B on the axis, second A1-B1 shifted right below, third A2-B2 shifted farther right below. The first is hatched; the latter two are unhatched outlines. A < A1 < A2 and B < B1 < B2 horizontally; all three rods have comparable equal lengths.
Upper double-ended dimension from initial A vertical to B1 vertical is labelled l + v tau1.
Short dimension from A vertical to A1 vertical between first and second rows is labelled v tau1.
Short dimension from A1 vertical to A2 vertical between second and third rows is labelled v tau2.
Lower double-ended dimension from A2 vertical to B1 vertical is labelled l - v tau2; B1 vertical is shared by the upper and lower travel dimensions.

inventory.uncertainty: Greek time glyphs are inventoried as tau1/tau2 by their visible form and the requested scope; their physical conventions will be checked separately against approved edition text, not inferred from candidate geometry.
